messages:
Nina (Sales): Heads-up: MerchantFlow (dp-90) reports checkout slowdowns after today's edge update. p95 jumped 160ms -> 610ms, throughput down ~55%. Req id sample=9b2a7.
Owen (Support): Ticket #8107 opened. Customer clip shows spikes starting 2025-04-18T11:42Z, console shows fallback events and high queue_depth on gpu-node-31.
Priya (PM): Priority? Contracted SLA for dp-90? Need triage decision: mitigation vs rollback. @Samir @Vera please investigate.
Samir (Eng): Looking at logs now. Which route?
Owen (Support): POST /v1/chat route=r-7c4d. Pinned model redwood-xlarge-v1 but console shows fallback to redwood-large-quant.
Vera (Infra): Deploy at 11:35 UTC changed routing/batching defaults. deploy-bot: release/2025-04-18 routing-batching-tweak. Node gpu-node-31 queue depth rose ~11:40.
deploy-bot: release/2025-04-18 completed.
Samir (Eng): Log snippet: 2025-04-18T11:42:05Z WARN batching: target 8->2 route=r-7c4d pool=dp-90
2025-04-18T11:42:07Z ERROR serve: queue_wait=0.98s req=9b2a7 model=redwood-xlarge-v1
2025-04-18T11:42:08Z INFO routing: fallback to redwood-large-quant req=9b2a7
Samir (Eng): Hypothesis: new batching heuristic lowered batch targets causing higher per-request overhead; fallback increased decode cost -> throughput collapse.
Nina (Sales): Customer wants immediate fix. Can we pin them to fast variant and raise burst?
Priya (PM): Agreed emergency mitigation: 1) pin dp-90 to redwood-xlarge-v1 non-quant; 2) set min_batch_size=6 for that pool; 3) monitor 30m, rollback release if unstable. Samir lead, Vera on capacity.
Samir (Eng): Applying override now.
Samir (Eng): Override applied at 11:48 UTC. p95 down to ~200ms in 5m, throughput recovering.
Owen (Support): Customer reports checkout flows nominal in test. They asked for ETA on permanent fix and whether credits apply.
Priya (PM): Next steps: open bug with logs + timeline, product to add "per-tenant burst controls" and "routing safe-mode" to roadmap. Infra to add queue-depth escalation playbook. Owners: Samir (eng), Vera (infra), Priya (product). Priority: P1 immediate bug, P2 roadmap items.
Nina (Sales): I'll inform customer and request confirmation for mitigation.
Samir (Eng): Filing bug and attaching canary configs/rollback steps.
Vera (Infra): Drafting queue-alert playbook.
Priya (PM): Closing thread for now; reopen if regression appears. :white_check_mark:
